facts.fact: Décret n° 2024-071/PR of 26 December 2024 requires telecom operators to record the ANID-issued NIU of every national and resident subscriber at SIM registration and to see the ANID identification card, giving existing operators 12 months from signature to comply; the text states no query of ANID's database.
